jewelry lead generation services

CaratBase delivers verified local leads to independent jewellers, estate buyers, and appraisers looking for sellers of gold, appraisal requests, or engagement rings. The first three leads are free, then you pay $40 per accepted lead.

What you get

First 3 leads free; $40 per accepted lead thereafter; optional valuation widget for your website at $29/month

Why CaratBase

Leads are screened and verified, ensuring you only contact prospects ready to sell or buy. We start in Atlanta and are expanding to other metro areas, so you can grow with us.

FAQ

How are the leads verified? CaratBase matches each inquiry to a local address and confirms intent before delivering the lead.

Can I cancel the valuation widget anytime? Yes, the $29/month widget can be paused or cancelled with no penalty.

Next step: Sign up now to claim your three free leads and start generating qualified jewelry sales opportunities.
